about.tagline: Here is where true beauty belongs.
about.subtitle: Since 2015 — True Beauty Comes From Within
about.founderQuote: Our mission is simple: make real beauty accessible to every African woman. Beauty Specialists, Your Skin Partners.
about.story1: Malkia B Cosmetics was born in 2015 from a simple yet powerful vision: to offer every African woman premium beauty care at accessible prices.
about.story2: Starting in Kigali, Rwanda, we expanded to Bukavu, DRC, reaching thousands of women with our carefully curated products.
about.story3: Today we ship worldwide, because beauty has no borders.
